scope: Academic CRITEO-UPLIFTv2.1 released-benchmark ranking and policy evaluation under the publisher's RCT-compatible-release assumptions; visit outcome only as primary, no ROI or transport to the original advertising population
rationale: New original-author evidence establishes pre-assignment covariates, two-week outcomes and common treatment ratio across experiments in v2; authors present balance validation and release explicitly for uplift benchmarking. File and rights verified; bounded protocol and prospective precision assessed before any new fit. GO is for this conditional benchmark claim, not identification of original-population effects after undisclosed label sampling.
assumptions: Publisher's corrected release retains RCT-compatible comparisons for its intended benchmark
Rows behave as independent user observations for benchmark uncertainty
Consistency and no material interference within the benchmark action definition
not_independently_verifiable: Original user/advertiser identity and cluster structure
Label-selection probabilities and original-population causal scale
Semantic mapping of anonymized feature values to business inputs

fallbacks.Lazada: NOT_SELECTED: dataset-folder license and fingerprints found, but sufficient pre-treatment feature timing and assignment details not established for this run
fallbacks.MT_LIFT: NOT_SELECTED: dataset reuse terms not established in publisher repository
